# Browser dependencies

- Marked 18.1.1: https://github.com/markedjs/marked (MIT).
- DOMPurify 3.4.17: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0).
- Mermaid 12.2.0: https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid (MIT). The `mermaid/` ES modules are built with esbuild 0.25.12 and loaded only when an architecture is opened. Flowchart chunks load on demand; other diagram chunks remain unused. The license and generated third-party notices are retained.

Copied from the named releases on registry.npmjs.org; license texts are retained here. These files are served locally with the site, without CDN requests.
